first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A handgun that remains in the lower-right foreground, with a short body and an angular slide; it appears dark green, nearly black, at the beginning and dark gray-black at the end.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: Large rectangular indoor wall panels ranging from gray to blue-gray, with rows of dark-colored rivets near the seams.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: A gray-brown to dark gray indoor floor assembled from rectangular panels, with a repeated fine grid texture on the surface.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: The dark-colored upper surface indoors, with multiple parallel layered trim strips at the wall-ceiling junction.

entities.name: hatch guardrail
entities.identification: Dark gray to black angled guardrails on both sides of the hatch; in frame 0 of this clip, only parts of them are exposed at the lower left and lower right edges, with the passage floor between them.

entities.name: gray fragments
entities.identification: A group of gray irregular panel-like fragments distributed near the base of the wall at the rear of the passage, including long narrow pieces and sharp-cornered pieces.

entities.name: yellow stain
entities.identification: Irregular yellow patches on the passage floor and at the base of the wall, accompanied by scattered small spots around them.

entities.name: indoor light fixture
entities.identification: Rectangular light fixtures on the ceiling, with gray outer frames and blue-white or warm-white illuminated surfaces.

entities.name: yellow-and-black marked horizontal barrier
entities.identification: A dark-colored elongated component inside an opening in the wall, with spaced yellow short blocks and parallel gray strip-like edges visible below.

entities.name: dark red rectangular panel
entities.identification: A partially exposed dark red rectangular surface in the upper part of the opening on the left, with a dark-colored vertical strip on its right edge.
